dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature of the trailing edge following a falcate profile from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute-angled tip with a narrow pixel radius, indicating a sharp morphological termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree posterior tilt relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.0:1.3 maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex curve forming a rounded anterior-dorsal profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum extending from the melon with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct concave transition notch between the melon and rostrum with an obtuse interior angle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly reflective circular specular highlight on the dorsal cranial region near the blowhole site.
